prompt: You operate an XYZ+yaw Cartesian robot with a parallel-jaw gripper. Reply JSON only. No tools. World X increases toward image right, Y away; yaw is counterclockwise from above. Images 480x360. Pixel coordinates (u,v) from top left. The gray movable component starts left of the dark receiving fixture with brass mating features. The task is to insert the unmarked two-hole keyed connector. Recipe dimension 21.2 mm, part outer width 24.0 mm, clearance per side 1.1 mm. First image is the original oblique view and second is live after model-commanded grasp/lift. The order specifies the near receiver: near means closer to the oblique camera (smaller world Y), far means further from it. One socket has an oversized far-side key pin and cannot seat this part. Use the compatible receiver specified by the order. Output pixel coordinates in the FIRST image. Third image is registered optical-axis depth of the first view, fixed viridis scale closest yellow at 235 mm, farthest purple at 355 mm. Command motion to the receiving feature and insertion followed by release. Give two points along the long mating axis at the 14 mm high peg tops, symmetric around the desired wrist center. For twin or connector use both pin tops. For a slot use the ends of the blade centerline. For D-shaft use ends of an axis passing through its shaft center and pointing to the flat, NOT the truncated silhouette midpoint. Correct for grasp offset if visible. Return {"op":"assemble","points":[[u1,v1],[u2,v2]]}.
